# Thirunavukarasu Palanisamy

> Robotics engineer working on robot perception, robot learning and control. Based in Chennai, India. Robotics, perception, robot learning and autonomy roles.

I build the software that lets robots see, move and decide what to do next: perception models, learned locomotion and driving policies, state estimation and control. I write my own implementations, test them properly, and report what actually worked, including the parts that didn't.

Also known as: Thirunavukarasu P, Thiru.

## Key facts
- Current role: Project Scientist, Department of Ocean Engineering, IIT Madras (since July 2026)
- Education: B.Tech, Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering, IIT Madras (2026)
- Indian provisional patent 202641100952 (Aug 2026)
- Internship: Robotics Intern, Pravahan Engineering (EKF sensor fusion of GNSS, IMU and Lidar; PID vs MPC control)
- Research: perception under degraded sensing (denoising, detection, 3D reconstruction)
- Skills: Languages: Python, C++, C#, Go, TypeScript, C, SQL, MATLAB; Robotics: ROS 2, Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, CARLA, MetaDrive, Unity, LeRobot; Robot learning: PyTorch, PPO / MAPPO, Imitation learning, World models, Transformers, Gymnasium; Perception: OpenCV, Open3D, YOLO, MediaPipe, CLIP, Whisper; Estimation & control: Extended Kalman Filter, Particle filters, PID, MPC, Leg odometry; Deployment: TensorRT, ONNX, CUDA, Docker, Linux, Git, pytest

## Robotics projects
- [Pedestrian crossing-intent prediction from pose, gesture and scene context](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/pedestrian-crossing-intent.html): Predicts whether a pedestrian will step onto the road 1.5 seconds before they do, using body pose and the scene around them. Result: 0.633 AP on real video (pose alone: 0.385).
- [Multi-agent reinforcement learning with intent inference at unsignalised intersections](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/intersection-negotiation-marl.html): Two self-driving cars learn to take turns at a junction with no lights or radio, by reading each other's motion. Result: 12 of 12 seeds solved, 0 collisions.
- [Demo-quality ablations for a vision-language-action model (SmolVLA) on LIBERO-10](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/robot-arm-demo-quality.html): Scores every teleoperated demo for how well it was driven, then trains a robot-arm policy on the best, worst and random halves. Result: 41.6% vs 40.0% vs 39.8% task success.
- [Privileged-learning transformer policy for rough-terrain quadruped locomotion](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/blind-quadruped-locomotion.html): A transformer policy that walks a four-legged robot over slopes and stairs using only what its joints feel. No camera, no lidar. Result: Teacher-student pipeline, 61 tests passing.
- [Perception and pull-direction selection for robotic sorting of pipe piles](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/robotic-pipe-sorting.html): An industry project: deciding which pipe a robot should pull from a jumbled pile, and in which direction. Result: Industry project, ongoing.
- [FP16 and INT8 TensorRT optimisation of YOLO11 for real-time road-user detection](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/realtime-detection-tensorrt.html): Runs YOLO11 detection on TensorRT at three precisions and measures accuracy, speed, memory and energy for each. Result: 574 FPS, 3.57x faster, -0.09 mAP.
- [World-model reinforcement learning for traffic-scene anticipation](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/traffic-world-model.html): A small DreamerV3-style world model, written from scratch, that imagines a traffic scene 15 steps ahead to test manoeuvres before doing them. Result: 4x more accurate than the baseline.
- [In-cabin speech and gesture grounding for driver-vehicle interaction](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/speech-gesture-grounding.html): Turns what a driver says and points at into an action, and asks a question instead of guessing when the two don't agree. Result: Silent wrong actions: 37.5% to 0%.
- [Reproduction and ablation of TITAN action priors for pedestrian trajectory forecasting](https://thiru51.github.io/thirunavukarasu-p.github.io/projects/titan-reproduction.html): Reimplemented TITAN (CVPR 2020) from the paper alone, with every prior on its own switch so the ablation can be run row by row. Result: Within 10% of published baselines.

## Other projects
- [LLM inference server](https://github.com/thiru51/tinyserve): Continuous batching and a paged KV cache for Qwen2.5-1.5B: 2,948 tokens/s, 7.6x faster than Hugging Face static batching.
- [Vector search in C++](https://github.com/thiru51/hnswlite): HNSW nearest-neighbour search from scratch with Python bindings: 14% faster than hnswlib at the same recall on SIFT-1M.
- [Kafka-style log in Go](https://github.com/thiru51/streamlog): 4.57M messages/s with fsync before every ack. Killed 200 times with kill -9 and lost 0 acknowledged records.
- [Product search engine in Go](https://github.com/thiru51/Scout): BM25F search over 1.2M products. Beats SQLite FTS5 on 22k human-labelled queries at 0.42 ms median latency.
- [API gateway in Go](https://github.com/thiru51/Tollgate): Load balancing, health checks and cluster-wide rate limits, adding only 475 ns per request at 110k requests/s.
- [Collaborative text editor](https://github.com/thiru51/Weave): A sequence CRDT written from scratch with live cursors and offline edits. Replays edits 3.5x faster than Yjs.
- [Vehicle telemetry pipeline](https://github.com/thiru51/fleet-telemetry-pipeline): ETL of 8.3M vehicle records into PostgreSQL. SQL alerts caught 22/22 tyre leaks with no false alarms.
- [Car-manual assistant](https://github.com/thiru51/incabin-rag-lora): A small LLM that answers from a car manual and says so when it can't. Training it to abstain cut silent errors from 80% to about 5%.
